as_told.title: Anderson's colleague at Area 51 also saw the green orb
as_told.place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana; Area 51

plain: A green, orb-shaped object is said to have flown over the Nevada test range while Randy Anderson, a guest who says he saw alien technology at a military base, was in training there, and Anderson says a buddy of his saw it. Michels later says that this colleague still works with Anderson at Area 51, the secret Air Force base in Nevada, and confirmed it: "yeah I saw that green orb that Randy talked about." Michels also brings up a DD214, the US military's discharge record, in the same breath, which, along with the colleague's word, he treats as support for Anderson's account.
